## 💡 Feature Value & Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe. (e.g. *"As a dispatcher, I need X so that I can accomplish Y..."*)

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you would like to see implemented. Outline changes to:
- **Backend API**: New REST endpoints, controller inputs, or business service logic.
- **Database Tables**: Schema migrations or new table mappings.
- **Frontend Panel**: UI inputs, interactive charts, or glassmorphic styling updates.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, designs, mockups, or diagrams about the feature request here.
